title: Add the disassembler and round-trip tests
lead: Disassemble a cell list back to source for debugging, and prove asm -> disasm -> asm round-trips.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** source formatting beyond what the round trip needs.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Acceptance criterion C17 requires the round trip. Disassembly is the v1 debugging aid.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- Assembler package: disassembler and round-trip tests.
- CLI package: the disassembly entry point.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- For every opcode, modifier and addressing mode: `assemble(disassemble(cells)) == cells`.
- Round trip over every worked example program in the spec docs.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: - Gap: PROJECT.md does not say how disassembly is invoked from the CLI. Propose a subcommand or flag to the owner.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- The project test command passes.
- Disassembling and reassembling each spec example gives identical cells.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Branch `slice/<id>-disassembler` in `.worktrees/<id>`. One commit when the owner asks.
